picks.rationale: Strongest AI-video-generation story in the pool: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5, now usable in Krea, produces complete 30s 4K clips with reference support and region-level editing — a concrete jump in controllable AI video film teams can put to work now.
picks.excerpt: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model, now usable in Krea, generates complete 30-second clips at up to 4K from a single prompt, adding stronger reference support and region-level editing over the prior version — a jump in controllable AI video for creative teams.

picks.rationale: Hard M&A news that reshapes the post toolchain: the de-facto AI upscaling/restoration stack (Topaz Video, Gigapixel, Astra) folds into Firefly and Creative Cloud, changing the roadmap and licensing for tools film finishers and restorers rely on. Acquisition chosen over the ProVideo review — same Topaz cluster, harder news.
picks.excerpt: Adobe signed a definitive agreement to acquire Texas-based Topaz Labs, whose AI tools cover upscaling, sharpening, stabilization, frame interpolation, noise removal and footage restoration (Topaz Video, Gigapixel, Astra, Bloom). Adobe plans to bring the enhancement models into Firefly, Firefly Services and Creative Cloud, with Topaz's on-device Neurostream tech.

picks.rationale: Included to reach the floor of 3: a zone-based color-grading overhaul in the dominant NLE — a real finishing-workflow shift for log/HDR footage, though its AI hook is thin (UI/tonal-model change rather than generative).
picks.excerpt: A deep dive into Premiere's new beta Color Mode, which replaces the traditional lift/gamma/gain model with a zone-based system built for log footage, wide-gamut media and HDR — Adobe's biggest color-grading rethink in the NLE in a decade.
